_comment: Aggregate measurement + segmentation config. Owned by ML role (docs/ML_ROLE.md section 1). These values are an exact mirror of the code defaults in backend/aggregate/measurement.py (MeasurementConfig), backend/aggregate/segmentation.py (WatershedConfig) and backend/aggregate/features.py (texture_statistics). tests/ml/test_configs.py round-trips this file against those dataclasses so the JSON cannot silently drift from code. Change the code, re-derive this file, and bump the *_version field.

measurement._min_diameter_note: Declared visible minimum particle diameter. Excluding smaller particles changes the reported density, so changing this requires a NEW reference version (final plan section 9.2, task D10).
measurement._min_gap_note: Declared lower reporting limit for gaps in pixels (final plan section 13.2).

watershed._min_instance_area_note: 0 means no minimum-area filter. On real CRKWH100 imagery the segmentation is texture noise (~2900 fragments at 3.57 px median diameter); a real minimum size needs verified scale (A1.6) and human labels (A2.3). Do not report these as chips (task A3.2).

texture._note: Fixed physical offsets. Unscaled imagery returns all-None proxies with a limitation rather than a fabricated number. These are unitless texture proxies, never mm roughness (final plan section 7.3).
